_how_to_use: Each question runs on every ESP unless 'esps' lists some. 'product' is what the question is about: 'loyalty', 'reviews', or null when it names no product (those run in arms A, C1 and C2 only and are scored on whether the answer asks or covers both). Real saved questions go in questions_real.json via `product_eval.py export-questions`.
